package.title: Mobile back button clears the chat selection (stale selectedChat reopens the old chat)

specification.intent: Mobile bug (operator, 2026-11-04): enter a chat, press back to the list, visit Contacts or Settings via the bottom bar, tap «Чаты» — you land in the previously opened chat instead of the chat list. Root cause: the mobile pane is derived from the store (chatPaneOpen = selectedChat != null, chat.ts:408) while the back button clears only the LOCAL prop (chat.ts:454-456), leaving selectedChat alive in the Store; the next page mount re-derives chatPaneOpen=true. Fix: onBack clears the selection in the store via a new ChatsController.closeChatFeed() (mirroring the existing store.set('selectedChat', undefined) writes at controller.ts:374/764); the page's existing CDU guard (chat.ts:631-636) collapses the pane on the defined→undefined transition, so the redundant local setProps is replaced by the controller call. Quick-change run on the quick-change preset obligations (one task, one owner, maxTaskAttempts 2, one review round).

requirements.title: Mobile back clears selectedChat in the store
requirements.description: ChatsController gains closeChatFeed(): store.set('selectedChat', undefined) — the ONLY new production write of that key besides the existing chat_deleted/leaveChat paths. The messenger back handler (chat.ts onBack) calls ChatsController.closeChatFeed() INSTEAD of the local this.setProps({chatPaneOpen: false}) — the existing CDU guard (selectedChat defined→undefined while chatPaneOpen===true → setProps({chatPaneOpen:false})) performs the visual collapse in the same store-emit cycle. Test pin in chat.test.ts next to the existing chatPaneOpen suites: with a chat selected and the pane open, invoking the page's onBack clears store.getState().selectedChat to undefined and the page props end with chatPaneOpen === false; a subsequent fresh mount derives the list view (chatPaneOpen false at construction). No other behavior changes: repeated chat selection (onSelectChat), the openDm-from-contacts entry with a preselected chat (starts at the feed bottom), chat_deleted and leaveChat paths stay untouched.

specification.goal: Tapping «Чаты» on the mobile bottom bar after leaving a chat via its back button shows the chat list, not the stale chat: back now deselects the chat in the store and the pane collapse rides the existing CDU guard.
constraints: The only new production write of selectedChat is closeChatFeed(); chat_deleted (controller.ts:374) and leaveChat (controller.ts:764) paths stay byte-identical.
No Router, store-slice, WS or messenger.hbs changes; guard-architecture --all --strict stays 0.
Existing suites stay green; mocha grows from the 654 base; no test deleted.
nonGoals: no per-chat routes (/messenger/:id) — separate optional feature
no change to the bottom-bar return semantics without pressing back (returning to an open chat is the existing deliberate behavior powering the openDm flow)
no desktop changes (the pane modifier applies below 768px only)
specification.scope: ChatsController.closeChatFeed + onBack rewiring + one chat.test.ts pin + progress_log record; evidence under work/2026-11-04-mobile-back-deselect/.

criteria.title: Back deselects the chat, return shows the list
criteria.statement: mocha proves: with a chat selected and the mobile pane open, invoking onBack clears store.getState().selectedChat to undefined and the page props end with chatPaneOpen === false (the CDU-guard collapse); a fresh mount after that derives the list view; chat_deleted, leaveChat and openDm preselection behaviors stay untouched. npm run verify exits 0 with mocha counts grown from the 654 base; no test deleted.

releaseImpact: ChatsController gains closeChatFeed() (the only new production write of selectedChat); the mobile messenger back button calls it instead of flipping a local prop, so the selection dies in the store and the existing CDU guard collapses the pane; one regression pin. No routing, store-slice, WS, template or backend changes.
